name: sg-smart-investor-ai
description: Production-ready PWA for monitoring Singapore shares with AI recommendations

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w apps/frontend" "npm run dev -w apps/backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/frontend && npm run build -w apps/backend
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/frontend && npm run test -w apps/backend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w apps/frontend && npm run test:coverage -w apps/backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/frontend && npm run lint -w apps/backend
scripts.format: npm run format -w apps/frontend && npm run format -w apps/backend
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check -w apps/frontend && npm run type-check -w apps/backend
